name: FusionGuard-Bench
description: FusionGuard-Bench is an auditable cross-domain benchmark and research resource for heterogeneous local feature matching and correspondence fusion. It evaluates classical and learned pipelines across IMC-13, HPatches, ScanNet, and a frozen ETH3D external module, comprising 1,740 image pairs grouped into 213 independent physical or sequence-level units. The v1.0.0 release contains frozen configurations, public pair manifests, pair-level evaluation records including failed estimates, independent process-A/process-B replay indices, exact model revision and checkpoint identifiers, release-wide SHA-256 manifests, and scripts that rebuild the reported tables and quantitative and qualitative figures. Prediction generation is separated from ground-truth evaluation, and bootstrap inference is performed at the independent-unit level. FusionGuard-Bench does not claim a new universal state of the art. It documents substantial cross-domain rank instability and provides external evidence for a positive rank-normalized fusion benefit on the frozen ETH3D module (Pose-AUC@10 difference 0.0430; 95% site-bootstrap CI 0.0111 to 0.0790). Third-party raw images, private ground truth, and model weights are not redistributed; official provider links, identifiers, revisions, and hashes are supplied instead.
